TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings directly relevant experience across (i) grid-connected solar energy deployments and (ii) delivery within public-sector healthcare environments, supported by ISO 9001-certified quality management [CO-PROFILE]. We are SECP incorporated, FBR-registered with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status, and maintain delivery offices in Lahore, Islamabad (HQ) and Karachi for multi-site execution and support [CO-PROFILE].

Most relevant past performance includes the following completed assignments (values/durations shown as executed):
- Solar Energy Deployment (Provincial Government), PKR 31M, 33 months, completed 2024 [CAP-008].
- Solar Energy Deployment (Federal Government), PKR 34M, 20 months, completed 2020 [CAP-020].
- Solar Energy Deployment (International), PKR 171M, 10 months, completed 2024 [CAP-032].
- Hospital IT Deployment (Federal Government), PKR 182M, 15 months, completed 2020 [CAP-042].
- Hospital IT Deployment (Provincial Government), PKR 66M, 28 months, completed 2023 [CAP-018].

This record demonstrates our ability to plan and deliver multi-stakeholder projects for federal/provincial clients in Pakistan—an explicit requirement of this RFP [CAP-020][CAP-042][CO-PROFILE]. For operations support, we operate an in-country support desk with 24–48 hour response SLAs and offer quarterly preventive maintenance on O&M contracts, aligning with the RFP’s O&M expectations [CO-PROFILE].

Our library does not yet evidence SCADA-based central dashboard delivery or DISCO net-metering approvals; we will address these mandatory requirements through a specialist solar monitoring/net-metering partner under our ISO 9001-governed delivery controls and PMP-led project management resources [CO-PROFILE].
